summary: Restoration is the dominant pledge: Venezuela aims to restore 215,520 ha by 2030, increase forest cover by 262,361 ha by 2030, and recover 791,050 ha of degraded land under land-degradation neutrality; annual reforestation commitments include 27,800 ha and a separate 25,000 ha/year. The 215,520-ha goal is about 0.41% of the 52.03 million ha currently mapped as forest. Conservation combines protection and management, including 28.72 million ha under strengthened ABRAE arrangements by 2030, 18.26 million ha of carbon sinks, 4.47 million ha monitored, and a 50% reduction in forest-fire incidence. Mixed measures cover 55,800 ha of forest management and 1,550 ha of community restoration. Agriculture targets 237,000 ha of sustainable or agroforestry production, 100,000 ha of cultivated land recovered and maintained each year, 542,246 ha under land-management plans in 2025–2030, and sustainable management of 30% of agricultural land. The annual 100,000-ha pledge equals roughly 0.78% of current agricultural cover; 237,000 ha equals 1.85%.
